controls.title: Audit/log records are determined, documented, implemented, and reviewed in accordance with policy
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That the audit policy itself was well-designed, that the right records were chosen for logging, or that review actually happened with adequate rigor.
controls.what_we_prove: Audit and log records submitted to the chain are stored with tamper-evident ordering, signed timestamps, and cryptographic anchoring. The records' implementation and accessibility for review are mathematically attestable.

controls.title: Event data are collected and correlated from multiple sources and sensors
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That all relevant sources were instrumented, that correlation logic was correct, or that anomalies were detected at the right time. The chain is the substrate for correlation, not the correlator.
controls.what_we_prove: Event data submitted to the chain — including data from multiple distinct sources — is stored with stable cryptographic ordering, allowing post-hoc correlation by an auditor. Each source's submissions are attributable and ordered.

controls.title: The network is monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That the monitoring coverage was adequate, that detections were timely, or that the monitoring system was correctly configured.
controls.what_we_prove: Network-monitoring events submitted to the chain are stored with tamper-evident ordering and signed timestamps. An auditor can reconstruct what the monitoring system observed and when.

controls.title: Personnel activity is monitored to detect potential cybersecurity events
controls.what_we_dont_prove: That all relevant personnel activity was monitored, that monitoring respected applicable employment-law constraints, or that detected events triggered appropriate response.
controls.what_we_prove: Personnel-activity events submitted to the chain are stored with stable ordering and signed timestamps. An auditor can verify what activity was observed and that the observation record has not been altered.

controls_out_of_scope.reason: asset management is inventory/governance, not chain-evidenced
supply chain risk management is contractual/procedural
access control design is system-level (specific access events covered under PR.PT-1)
information protection processes are operational design
communications and control networks are network-architecture
mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience — operational
baseline of network operations is a definition, not chain-evidenced
detected events analysis is an analyst activity
event impact determination is an analyst judgment
physical environment monitoring is out of scope for a cryptographic audit chain
specific malicious-code, mobile-code, external-service-provider, unauthorized-personnel/connections, and vulnerability-scan monitoring designs are tool-level
detection processes (roles, accountability, testing) are operational
mitigation execution may be logged but planning is procedural
